services.desc: Atsuko Okatsuka is a Taiwanese-Japanese American stand-up comedian, writer, and actor based in Los Angeles. She began her comedy career in 2008 and quickly gained recognition for her unique blend of absurdity and heartfelt humor. In 2022, she was named one of *Variety’s Top 10 Comics to Watch* and became the second Asian American woman to release a stand-up special on HBO with *The Intruder*. Atsuko is also known for creating the viral #DropChallenge and for her work on shows like *The Eric Andre Show* and *Fairview*.
